title: Private Berlin Tour for Groups - Quick Summary
items: **Choose private when the route is the real question.** Mixed interests, a useful start or end, a specific pace or three must-see places can justify a tailored walk.

**Choose the free tour when a fixed central introduction is enough.** BerlinWalk lasts about 2 hours from the World Clock on Alexanderplatz towards Hackescher Markt, with the live calendar deciding the date and time.
**Start with three real places.** Alexanderplatz, Museum Island, Brandenburg Gate, East Side Gallery and Charlottenburg Palace reveal whether the day stays central or needs a custom route.
**Do not turn every saved pin into a promise.** One main area plus one flexible second stop is usually stronger than a cross-city checklist.
Use the Berlin Private Route Brief to connect three places, then ask about a private walk if the route needs a human answer.
